ञ: ञ 1. ञ, the nasal belonging to the palatal class of letters. It only really occurs in conjunction with palatal consonants; and when preceding च्, छ्, has much the sound of न् in inch; when preceding ज्, झ्, much the sound of n in singe. —न-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ञ्।
ञ 2. ञ, अस्, m. a singer; any jingling or inarticulate sound; a heretic, an apostate; an ox; a N. of Śukra, regent of the planet Venus.
